payload.name: Preserve Original Event Date When Enriching Memories
payload.description: When updating or merging an existing event memory with related details from a later message, use this before changing world_start: keep the original event date unless the new message explicitly revises it.
content: During CRUD update/merge, when a later message adds related information about an already-recorded event, do not overwrite world_start with the later message's date/time. Preserve the original event date unless the new message explicitly states the event occurred on a different date.

Treat updates that only add related details (e.g., outcome, response, elaboration) as enrichment: keep all existing temporal fields unchanged and modify only the content fields the new message actually changes.

solves: A later message enriches an already-recorded event with new related details, and the memory update incorrectly changes the event's original world_start to the date of the later message, losing the ability to answer when the event happened. Use this rule when adding details during CRUD update/merge: preserve the original event date unless the new message explicitly restates the event with a different date. This applies broadly to any future enrichment of an existing event; it does not apply when the new message explicitly revises the event's occurrence date.
